title: LokSetu
description: A civic engagement platform connecting citizens with local government services, enabling real-time grievance tracking and community-driven problem solving.
longDescription: LokSetu bridges the gap between citizens and local municipal bodies through a modern, mobile-first platform. Citizens can file complaints, track their status in real-time, vote on community priorities, and connect with local representatives. Built with scalability in mind, LokSetu supports multiple municipalities and handles thousands of concurrent users.
features: Real-time grievance tracking with status updates via SMS & email
Interactive community voting on local priorities
